 Skylar Russell November 16, 2026, 6:00 pm 
 Facebook

 Here is your fight size update for Monday, November 16, 2026.
 – A new logo and shirt has been revealed for Pharaoh Rhodes — the late dog of Cody Rhodes:
 Every American Nightmare needs a loyal companion. Cody Rhodes’ Siberian Husky, Pharaoh, won fans over backstage and on the ramp—and now he’s featured on Cody’s latest tee. Available now at #WWEShop #WWE 🛒: https://t.co/31r13IdNZ5 pic.twitter.com/WSygLvLkZV 
 — WWEShop.com (@WWEShop) November 16, 2026 
 – Alexa Bliss is on the latest episode of WWE Day Off:
 – Carlie Bravo is calling for Lee Moriarty to be added to the Continental Classic:
 Put TAIGASTYLE in the C2.
 — Bad News & Tattoos (@CarlieBravo) November 16, 2026 
 – Mystii Marks has been announced for WrestleRave Season’s Beatings! 
 – Bear Bronson has been pulled from NHB Vol. 104 and Vol. 105 due to travel issues.
 – Logan Paul is looking for a new editor for his YouTube channel:
 I’m looking for an editor for my vlogs on my 23.6M subscribed YouTube channel (& various other high level media content)
 Specifically searching for someone who’s worked with big YouTube channels before, is comfortable making creative decisions, hitting weekly deadlines, and…
 — Logan Paul (@LoganPaul) November 16, 2026 
 – Barstool Eddie linked up with Bret Hart at Big Event NY over the weekend.
 – Mina Shirakawa will take on Corinne Joy at Crimson City Fights in January.
 – ICYMI: wXw has announced a huge show for November 2027:
 wXw Announces the Biggest Event in Its History
 The big news broke on Friday morning. In a video recorded at the venue, legendary ring announcer Thomas Giesen unveiled the biggest project in wXw history. After more than 30 years, professional wrestling is returning to the… pic.twitter.com/dsu3hYcsl8 
 — wXw Germany (@wXwGermany) November 16, 2026 
 – Have you ever tried to be Nic Nemeth in a McDonalds? Well, this person has, so level up your game.
 – Vipress and Nino Extremo will challenge for the GCW Tag Team Championships in December!
